i’ve been getting a lot of questions about what websites i used or how else you can find these auditions (but i’m afraid it’s a little more complicated than that) - but DW i’ll break it down below 🫶🏻🫶🏻

i’m also not the most qualified person to be explaining this since i haven’t booked that many roles, but i’ll give you what i know!!

my journey:

i started acting when i was 13 by enrolling in a professional child actor classes. the studio had a lot of connections to agents, so after every term there was a showcase where agents would come watch the kids perform, and if they liked you they would sign you to their roster. i got picked, and that’s when i started receiving auditions from my agent. my first two years of auditioning i didn’t get a single booking :( until i booked my first role on avatar where i appeared on all 3 seasons 🪭 and later the power ⚡️! 

here’s how the industry works:

there are open casting calls sometimes where anyone without an agent can submit, but the chances of being successful there are very slim. normally you get an agent, the agent sends a picture of you to casting, and if casting thinks you’ll be good for the character that’s when they send you an audition invite. you can’t really audition whenever you want, casting is the one who sends you the invite.

so if i was just starting out, this is what i would do:

1. look at acting classes in your city. even if they don’t have connections to agents it’s a great way to learn more about the industry and how to act. this matters because when you’re auditioning for bigger productions you’re competing against people who have been acting for ages and when you do get booked, production doesn’t rly train u much, ur expected to know how to act.

2. volunteer for student films to start building your demo reel. do a simple search on facebook or see if ur city has a designated site

3. (optional) sign up to do background work to get used to the environment on set.

4. once you have some experience, search up acting agencies near you and apply!

5. once u get an agent, u will start auditioning!
